global-property.name: env
global-property.doc:name: Global Property
global-property.doc:description: Active environment: local by default; CloudHub passes env=cloud

configuration-properties.doc:name: Configuration properties
configuration-properties.doc:description: Environment properties: listener, requests store, papi-orders, approvers, expiry and RabbitMQ

secure-properties:config.name: Secure_Properties_Config
secure-properties:config.doc:name: Secure Properties Config
secure-properties:config.doc:description: INTEGRATION_APP and RabbitMQ users and passwords encrypted with AES/CBC. The key is passed with -M-Dencryption.key

configuration.doc:description: Global error handler: turns any error into the contract ErrorResponse

http:listener-config.name: papi-order-requests-httpListenerConfig
http:listener-config.doc:name: HTTP Listener config
http:listener-config.doc:description: API HTTP listener. Host and port come from the environment properties

http:listener-connection.doc:description: Opens the environment HTTP port; on CloudHub the load balancer terminates TLS

db:config.name: requests-db-config
db:config.doc:description: Connection to the INTEGRATION_APP schema (requests store). Host, port, service, pool and reconnection come from the properties

http:request-config.name: papi-orders-http-config
http:request-config.doc:description: HTTP client for papi-orders (order lookup and approved corrections)

amqp:config.name: rabbitmq-amqp-config
amqp:config.doc:description: RabbitMQ connection to publish approval.requested and correction.applied

error-handler.name: global-error-handler
error-handler.doc:name: Error Handler
error-handler.doc:description: Turns any error into the contract ErrorResponse with the matching HTTP status

on-error-propagate.doc:name: On Error Propagate
on-error-propagate.doc:description: Handles APIkit, business (APP), database (DB) and downstream (HTTP) errors

logger.doc:description: Logs the error type, its description and the correlationId

ee:transform.doc:description: Resolves HTTP status, code, message and retryable flag from the error type
Builds the ErrorResponse, the HTTP status and the Retry-After header when the error is a 503
